description: Finds specs on Spekkr by words, the best match first, with each one's id, summary and platforms. Most build a part of an app; a spec that builds something else, such as a CAD model, a circuit or an animation, says so under kind. Search with a few words that name the thing, such as "sign in" or "sliding puzzle"; a slip in a long word is forgiven. When no spec holds every word, the specs that hold some of them are returned and partial is true. Leave query out to list the specs, the ones pulled most first. An answer holds at most limit specs: total counts the specs that matched, and offset reads further into them. catalogTotal counts every spec there is. A spec with publishedBy was published by a member. A spec with forkedFrom began as a copy of that spec. A spec that has been pulled or starred says how often: pulls in all, pullsThisWeek in the last seven days, and stars, each left out when zero. updated is the day its newest version was published; a spec Spekkr lists itself has none.

kind.description: Only specs of this kind, such as CAD or animation. Each spec names its kind in its own words, so any text is allowed; capitals are ignored. A spec that names no kind builds software.

limit.description: How many specs to return at most. 20 when left out.

offset.description: How many of the specs that matched to pass over first. 0 when left out.

platform.description: Only specs that target this platform.

query.description: Words to look for in a spec's name, keywords, id, kind, stack, summary and platforms. A word may be only the start of one. Small words such as "the" and "for" are left out.

name: search_specs
title: Search specs
